desc: Introducing the Retay RA1522 - a.22LR designed to be a less expensive alternative for training, recreational shooting, and even small game hunting. With less recoil, noise, and a heck of a lot more fun, the RA 1522 will ease new enthusiasts into the sport, allowing them to become familiar with the unique style of rifle platforms. The reliability of the RA1522 will satisfy the most experienced shooter, while impressing amateurs with the feel, performance, accuracy, and quality of engineering.
